before_ordering.title: r2 verification before ordering
before_ordering.intro: Do these before paying for anything:

steps.label: Done
steps.summary: r2 pipeline, both halves generated, routed, ERC/DRC clean, gerbers exported, renders in the README
steps.text: Done: r2 pipeline, both halves generated, routed, ERC/DRC clean, gerbers exported, renders in the README (hw-two-pcbs-r2). The left board is the x mirror of the layout frame since 2026-11-06 (hw-left-pcb-mirror, done).

steps.label: Done (automated part)
steps.summary: independent gerber parse of all three zips in tests/test_gerbers.py (layers, drills, outlines, the pocket notch, no copper in the notch)
steps.open: upload hardware/left-pcb/k0d3ball35-left-gerbers.zip, hardware/right-pcb/k0d3ball35-right-gerbers.zip and hardware/sensor-pcb/fab/k0d3ball35-sensor-r1-gerbers.zip to the JLCPCB preview
steps.text: Done (automated part): independent gerber parse of all three zips in tests/test_gerbers.py (layers, drills, outlines, the pocket notch, no copper in the notch). Open: upload hardware/left-pcb/k0d3ball35-left-gerbers.zip, hardware/right-pcb/k0d3ball35-right-gerbers.zip and hardware/sensor-pcb/fab/k0d3ball35-sensor-r1-gerbers.zip to the JLCPCB preview. Ticket test-fab-gerber-viewer.

steps.label: Mostly done
steps.summary: the two defects of the first review (power switch rotation, USB overhang) are fixed and tests/test_pcb_review.py covers sockets, FH12, controller, battery bay, holes, notch, silkscreen and GND pours
steps.open: 3D viewer pass, 1:1 paper check with a real socket and MSK12C02, routing eyeball
steps.text: Mostly done: the two defects of the first review (power switch rotation, USB overhang) are fixed and tests/test_pcb_review.py covers sockets, FH12, controller, battery bay, holes, notch, silkscreen and GND pours. Open for the user: 3D viewer pass, 1:1 paper check with a real socket and MSK12C02, routing eyeball. Tickets hw-main-pcb-review-r1, hw-gnd-stitching-review (non-blocking).

steps.label: In parallel with the order (no longer a gate)
steps.summary: cradle test print and sensor fit, print hardware/trackball-cradle/stl/cradle-19mm-pocket.stl and the optional retainer-19mm.stl, fit a sensor board (or a 26 x 25 mm dummy), check the lens gap with a feeler gauge
steps.text: In parallel with the order (no longer a gate): cradle test print and sensor fit, print hardware/trackball-cradle/stl/cradle-19mm-pocket.stl and the optional retainer-19mm.stl, fit a sensor board (or a 26 x 25 mm dummy), check the lens gap with a feeler gauge; the ball must spin without touching the rim, and with the retainer clipped on it must stay in upside down. Tickets hw-sensor-stack-height, mech-lm18-lens-outline-measurement, mech-ball-retainer-clip.

steps.label: Ball sourcing and tracking
steps.summary: order a pack of 3/4 inch POM balls (and a PandaKB TB19) and a bag of 2 mm ZrO2 balls now, test them on the sensor board as soon as it exists
steps.text: Ball sourcing and tracking: order a pack of 3/4 inch POM balls (and a PandaKB TB19) and a bag of 2 mm ZrO2 balls now, test them on the sensor board as soon as it exists. Tickets hw-19mm-ball-sourcing, hw-ball-colour-tracking-test.

steps.summary: FFC pin order with a physical cable and both connectors
steps.text: FFC pin order with a physical cable and both connectors; the desk check is done and tested (tests/test_ffc_pin_order.py). Ticket hw-ffc-pin-order-verification.

steps.label: Then order
steps.summary: hw-jlcpcb-order-r1, shop by shop per spec/12-order-checklist.md
steps.text: Then order: hw-jlcpcb-order-r1, shop by shop per spec/12-order-checklist.md.
